lessons.title: A school equipment inquiry
lessons.subtitle: Read a clear request for a catalog, product information, and school discounts.
lessons.subject: Request for 2026 Product Catalog and Pricing Information

blocks.text: I am writing to request a copy of your 2026 Science Equipment Catalog.

Bright Horizon School is planning to upgrade our science classrooms, and we have heard excellent feedback about your equipment. We are considering purchasing new tools and materials for our students and would like more information about your products.
Specifically, we are interested in the following items:
list: Laboratory glassware (such as beakers and test tubes)

blocks.text: If a digital version (PDF) of your catalog is available, please email it to me. If you provide a printed catalog, kindly mail a copy to the school address listed above.
Additionally, I would like to ask if you offer bulk-purchase discounts for schools. We are preparing to place an order for the upcoming semester and would appreciate information about your pricing.
Thank you for your assistance. I look forward to your reply.

comprehension: Why is Bright Horizon School requesting the 2026 Science Equipment Catalog?
The school plans to upgrade its science classrooms and wants more information before purchasing new tools and materials.
What specific types of equipment is the school interested in purchasing?
Digital microscopes, laboratory glassware such as beakers and test tubes, and electronic scales.
What two formats of the catalog does the sender mention?
A digital PDF catalog and a printed catalog.
What additional information does the sender request regarding pricing?
Information about pricing and bulk-purchase discounts for schools.
When does the school need the equipment?
For the upcoming semester.
matching: To improve something or replace it with a better version
A list of items, often with descriptions and prices
To buy a large quantity of items at one time
To ask for something politely or formally
Ready to be used, bought, or obtained
To be thankful for something or to understand its value

lessons.title: A supplier inquiry for FreshMart
lessons.subtitle: Ask for the commercial details needed before choosing a supplier.

blocks.text: I am writing on behalf of FreshMart Grocery Store to inquire about your canned food products. We are currently looking for reliable suppliers for canned fish, canned fruit, and canned vegetables, as we plan to expand our product selection for the upcoming year.
We would appreciate it if you could provide more detailed information about the following:
list: The types and varieties of canned fish, fruit, and vegetables you produce (e.g., tuna, sardines, peaches, pineapples, corn, peas).
Your wholesale price list, including discounts for large or repeated orders.
The minimum order quantity for each product line.
Available packaging sizes and materials (such as 185g, 350g, 1kg cans).
The shelf life of your products and recommended storage conditions.
Estimated delivery time, payment terms, and shipping options for orders to Seattle.
Whether your company can provide sample products for us to evaluate quality before placing a bulk order.

blocks.text: If possible, please also send us your latest product catalog or a link to your online version. This will help us better understand your full range of canned products.
Thank you very much for your time and assistance. We look forward to receiving your reply and hope we can establish a long-term business relationship with your company.

comprehension: Why is FreshMart Grocery Store contacting Pacific Harvest Foods?
To inquire about canned food products and find reliable suppliers as it expands its product selection.
What three categories of products does FreshMart want to know about?
Canned fish, canned fruit, and canned vegetables.
Name three types of information FreshMart requests.

For example: wholesale prices and discounts, minimum order quantities, and packaging sizes. Other valid answers include product varieties, shelf life and storage conditions, delivery, payment and shipping details, and samples.
Where is the order expected to be shipped?
Seattle.
What does the company want to receive before placing a large order? Why?
Sample products, so it can evaluate their quality before placing a bulk order.
What additional material does the sender request to learn more about the company’s products?
The latest product catalog or a link to the online version.
trueFalse: FreshMart Grocery Store is writing to place an order immediately.
It is requesting information before making a purchasing decision.
The purpose of the letter is to inquire about canned food products.
The opening paragraph states this purpose.
FreshMart is only interested in canned fish products.
It is interested in canned fish, canned fruit, and canned vegetables.
The company is looking for reliable suppliers to expand its product selection.
This is stated in the opening paragraph.
The letter asks for information about wholesale prices and discounts.
The second request asks for a wholesale price list and discounts.
Packaging sizes such as 180g, 250g, and 2kg are mentioned in the letter.
The sizes in the letter are 185g, 350g, and 1kg.
The sender requests information about delivery to Los Angeles.
The requested delivery destination is Seattle.
FreshMart asks about maximum order quantity for each product line.
It asks about the minimum order quantity.
The company wants to evaluate product quality before making a bulk purchase.
It requests samples to evaluate quality before placing a bulk order.
The letter expresses interest in establishing a long-term business relationship.
The closing paragraph expresses this hope.

To judge or examine something carefully
To ask for information or details
Acting for another person or organization
